claims.text: The threshold values are chosen to ensure the distribution of class labels is about 1:10, with distituents being the majority.
The thresholds τ min and τ max are set to 0.0005 and 0.995 to define gold-standard outside strings for constituents and distituents.
The selection of thresholds takes into account the skewness of random spans, ensuring that distituents outnumber constituents.
